DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_id as "incidentReportId", alarm_config_id as "alarmConfigId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", activation as "activation", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ims_incident_report_alarms WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_report_alarms (incident_report_id, alarm_config_id, element_type_id, element_id, activation, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentReportId , :alarmConfigId , :elementTypeId , :elementId , :activation , :enabled , :visible , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ims_incident_report_alarms WHERE incident_report_id = :incidentReportId AND alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
